values: Source of truth for plan selection, camera support, session storage, and the progress leaderboard.
March in place, roll your shoulders, then open the hips gently.
Stand tall, sit the hips back, reach a comfortable depth, then stand.
Move from feet-together and arms-down to feet-apart and hands overhead.
Use a stable desk edge or your knees; keep a straight line through the torso.
Lie side-on to the camera, curl the shoulders toward the hips, then return with control.
Brace gently and hold a straight, comfortable position. Stop if it feels painful.
Walk slowly, breathe evenly and stretch only within a comfortable range.
Step back under control and use a wall for support if needed.
Use a lightly loaded backpack and pull it toward your ribs with a long spine.
March at a comfortable pace, keeping your torso tall and arms relaxed.
